title: Baseball Is Canadian Long Sleeve Tee White - Unisex
description:
Before there were big leagues and stadium lights, there was Beachville, Ontario — the site of the first recorded professional baseball game back in 1838. So yeah, Baseball is Canadian. Fast forward to today, and Canada’s team is back in the World Series for the first time in 32 years. This sweatshirt is a nod to our place in the game’s history — and the electric feeling of October baseball in the North. Made in Canada, naturally. Baseball might be America’s pastime, but Canada has always been a major player.

title: Reverse Fleece Pullover Navy - Unisex
description:
What if Province of Canada made a ‘fleece’ or what some folks call a ‘Polar fleece’? For starters, we wouldn’t use 100% polyester, or even recycled polyester (both are bad) — our ‘fleece’ would have to be 100% cotton. ‘But cotton fleece isn’t fuzzy’. It is if you reverse it, so that’s exactly what we did. We took our heavy weight, 20oz cotton, fluffed it up and reversed it. The end result gave us that ‘Polar fleece’ feeland vibe without the microplastics. So yeah, what if Province of Canada made a ‘fleece’? Yeah, what if.

Our Country Club is for those who appreciate our made in Canada design approach. Think classic, easygoing items with a hint of "weekend getaway uniform," but you don’t need to "know somebody" or a secret handshake to get in.

Our club is less about "unaccessible luxury", and more about, laid-back style with a few upscale touches. Easy, effortless classics with a dash of preppy charm. Clean-cut half zips, lived-in sweatshirts, perfectly draped sweatpants, throw-it-on-and-go tees, and relaxed but timeless baseball hats, all crafted by our team here in Canada.

The only membership requirement for our Country Club? A love for quality, community, and, of course, the whole made in Canada thing. Welcome to the club.

  • Reverse Flatlock Stitching.

title: Forest Pouch
description:
A few years ago, while thrifting, our co-founder Julie came across a denim duffle bag and a denim pouch. She fell in love with the relaxed, lived in, practicality of these two unassuming travel buddies. Her obsession with these objects inspired our entire team to recreate them with a made in Canada spin.

Our Pouch is perfect for, well everything. Neatly sort your personal items, cords or makeup, secured with a gold YKK zipper closure. Finished with our woven Flag label.

title: Wordmark Tote Bag Forest
description:
Our newest Tote Bag is more of a Bag, than a tote. Made with thick cotton fabric, with an inside pocket and durable straps. Long enough for on or off shoulder carry. It's the ideal bag for weekend getaways, the beach, groceries, or pretty much anything.

We're all about a 'plastic free' lifestyle. Roughly three billion (that's billion with a 'B') plastic bags are used in Canada each year, and most are used for less than 20 minutes each but take hundreds of years to break down. Moral of the story, don't use plastic bags, use a Tote Bag instead.

  • Made in Canada.
  • 100% Cotton, 12oz Brushed Twill.
  • Printed Straps.
  • Inside Pocket.
  • Flag label on side seam.
  • Dimensions: Height 12", Bottom Width 14.5", Top Width 21.5", Depth 6", Strap Length 11.5".

title: Wordmark Tote Bag Black
description:
Our newest Tote Bag is more of a Bag, than a tote. Made with thick cotton fabric, with an inside pocket and durable straps. Long enough for on or off shoulder carry. It's the ideal bag for weekend getaways, the beach, groceries, or pretty much anything.

We're all about a 'plastic free' lifestyle. Roughly three billion (that's billion with a 'B') plastic bags are used in Canada each year, and most are used for less than 20 minutes each but take hundreds of years to break down. Moral of the story, don't use plastic bags, use a Tote Bag instead.

  • Made in Canada.
  • 12oz, 100% Cotton Canvas.
  • Printed Straps.
  • Inside Pocket.
  • Flag label on side seam.
  • Dimensions: Height 12", Bottom Width 14.5", Top Width 21.5", Depth 6", Strap Length 11.5".

title: The Cottage Candle
description:
You haven’t hit true Cottage mode until you find yourself with your feet up, flipping through an issue of Cottage Life Magazine. We don’t make the cottage rules, that’s just what it is. Cottage Life began as a magazine and from there established itself as the brand dedicated to everything ‘I wish I was at the cottage’.

For their 35th anniversary, we’ve collaborated with Cottage Life on a collection inspired by the early years of the magazine. We dove into their archives and created pieces that are a modern take on the summer of ’88.

There’s something very Canadian about a candle. There’s something even more Canadian about a candle when it’s hand poured in Canada. Our natural, non-GMO soy wax candles have a 60 hour burn time and a 15 foot scent throw.

Candle quip: The smell of the place you'd rather be.
Scent notes: Sweetgrass, Cedarwood and a touch of fresh air.

  • Non-GMO soy wax

title: Maison Baseball Hat Natural Forest
description:
Once upon a time in the charming neighbourhood of Leslieville, there stood a fashion house like no other – "Maison Province Du Canada." This unique brand had captured the hearts of fashion enthusiasts across the country and beyond, not only for its exquisite designs but for its distinctive approach to the "art de vivre".

At first glance, Maison Province Du Canada might have seemed like any other loungewear label, with its elegant storefront on Queen Street East and its world class customer service. But what set this fashion house apart was its unwavering commitment to Canadian manufacturing and a healthy dose of playful irreverence.

We set out to create the best fitting, most comfortable, made in Canada baseball hat. After many samples, we landed on an adjustable, 6 panel, cotton twill cap style with just the right amount of structure. A classic that looks good on everyone.

  • Made in Canada.
  • Forest Embroidery.
  • One size fits most.
  • 100% Cotton, 8oz Twill.
  • 6 Panel Construction.
  • Adjustable Strap with Metal Clasp.
  • View our Hat Collection.

description:

title: Dryer Ball Grey
description:
They help clothes dry faster, become softer, and come out of the dryer with less wrinkles and static cling. They eliminate the need for dryer sheets and fabric softener. They're a natural, chemical free way to soften laundry in the dryer, with less impact on the environment. We recommend using 3 for a normal sized load and 6 for bulky items.

Pure Wool Dryer Balls are excellent for fluffing up cloth diapers, down jackets, duvets, towels & blankets. They will not harm your clothing or your dryer & the wool does not rub off or unravel. There are no fillers, dyes, perfumes or chemicals, only pure wool. They last for 100+ loads.

  • Made In Canada

  • Available in Grey and White.

title: Reverse Fleece Pullover Black - Unisex
description:
What if Province of Canada made a ‘fleece’ or what some folks call a ‘Polar fleece’? For starters, we wouldn’t use 100% polyester, or even recycled polyester (both are bad) — our ‘fleece’ would have to be 100% cotton. ‘But cotton fleece isn’t fuzzy’. It is if you reverse it, so that’s exactly what we did. We took our heavy weight, 20oz cotton that is grown in the United States and milled in Canada, fluffed it up and reversed it. The end result gave us that ‘Polar fleece’ feel and vibe without the non-renewable petroleum. So yeah, what if Province of Canada made a ‘fleece’? Yeah, what if.

  • Made in Canada.
  • Unisex. Women should size down.
  • 100% Cotton.
  • 20oz Reverse Fleece.
  • Kangaroo Pocket.
  • Flag Label on Cuff.
  • Branded Brass Snaps.
  • Flatlock Stitching.
